note: Identity caveat: the batch name 'Tatva Chintan Chemicals Chem pharma private limited' does not exactly match any registry name found. Promoter/legal_claimed 'PINAKINBHAI VAKHARIA' was not verified against any public source in this session (search backend was unavailable). Role: manufacturer (own plants, own branded product list, own overseas subsidiaries as buyers). Export status is confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code, not by website claims. Domestic supply remains unverified — no public GST/tender/contract evidence was retrieved, so it is recorded as unknown rather than assumed.
